template.name: template_clubbox_move_cost

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED)
local clubbox = game.player():currentyActiveClubbox() local switchCost = math.floor(clubbox:curHype() / 1000) if switchCost > 0 then component("text"):SetString("-"..game.commaizeNumber(switchCost)) end
game.StoreContext_setCurrencyTypeColour(game.StoreContext_TYPE_DIAMOND, component);
component("layer"):SetString("ContextBar")

template.event: local text = element["Text"] text:setColor(text("red"):GetFloat() * 2.0, text("green"):GetFloat() * 2.0, text("blue"):GetFloat() * 2.0)
local text = element["Text"] text:setColor(text("red"):GetFloat() * 0.5, text("green"):GetFloat() * 0.5, text("blue"):GetFloat() * 0.5)
